$comment: The engine's own vocabulary (D17). The harness_blindness self-test in checks/run-all.mjs flags product nouns — HTTP route paths, SQL table names — that appear in engine code (checks/, scripts/, workflows/, hooks/, policy/) but are not listed here. Product knowledge must enter runs as DATA through three doors — the vision/spec documents, the planner's judged artifacts, and the tester's judged probe plan — never as engine code. Test fixtures (*.test.mjs), settled.json rationale, and this file are exempt.
